translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: 2 Corintios
book.title: An tsabchilab u axi thuchanchat an ebchalabchic ti Corinto c’al an t’ocat abathuale Pablo

content: In eyaltal a Pablo ti abathuale c’al a Cristo

Nana’ im Pablo u le’ tu ucha’chic i cau c’al i maxutalab ani c’al i c’aya’talab ejtil max pel a Cristo ax ti uchalchic. U uxnal abal in maxu tam in c’uajat c’al tata’chic ani im pathay tam yab in c’uajat c’al tata’chic.

Nan tu lej uchalchic abal tiquin tequeth tsalpanchi u ey abal tam quin ulits c’al tata’chic yab cu yejenchi tu tauna’chic c’al i pathaytalab. In ts’ejcathits tu tauna’chic antsana’ max jita’ tin tsalpanchale u ey ejtil in ey jahuaquitsq’ui tam inic axi yab exlom c’al a Dios.
Aba ani’ huahua’ axi pel tu abathuale c’al a Dios pel tu inic teje’ tsabal, bel yab i eyenthal i cuete’ tsalap c’al jahua’ ax tu tomolnal teje’ tsabal.
Yab i eyenthal i eyextalab ts’ejcath c’al i inic, tocat jahua’ lej tsaplix tu pithamal a Dios qui eyentha’ abal qui talabethanchi jahua’ t’ayat tomolnax c’al a Dios.

C’al xe’ i talabethanchal i tsalap ax u c’ambixnab c’al an inic. I paclunchal jahuaquits tam c’athat tsalap ani i c’athat cau ax u eyenthab c’al axi pel i tomolnax c’al a Dios ani yab in jilal in at inicchic quin exla’ a Dios. I lubal qui tala’ jilchi tin c’ubac a Cristo in jec’omnax ichich tim patal an inicchic ca belcaxmethanchat c’al jaja’.
Ani tata’chic jaye ca jum putat t’ajchichic jahua’ in le’ a Cristo, max i huahua’ u ts’ejcathits tu ts’ejca’ jahuaquitsq’ui tam jec’omtalab ani tu bijchi i yajchictalab c’al a jec’omtal.

Tata’chic ojni’ tocat a t’ajchal ti cuenta jant’ini’ tu tsu’tab eleb an inic. Max hua’ats jita’chic in tsalpayal abal pel in lej chubax c’al a Cristo, quin t’aja’chic ti cuenta abal huahua’hue pel tu lej chubax c’al a Cristo.

Hualam max u hue’ huat’ath ajatnal u eyaltal tin abathuale c’al an Ajatic. Max ani’ u t’ajal, bel yab in tithebel cum tim pithamalits an Ajatic u eyaltal abal nan tu tolminchi c’al a ejattal ani iba abal tu othnanchichic.
Yab u le’ abal ca tsalpaychic max nan tu thuchanchal i u abal tu jiq’uetha’chic.
Jahua’ u thuchal lej yajchic ani lej tsapiccua’. Lej palu u ey ani u cahuintal ni jant’o ti exbathcua’.
Jitats quin ulu antsana’ quin lej tsalpanchi abal u ey ax u tejhua’methanchal c’al jahua’ u thuchal, ja’its jaye axi ne’ets tu tejhua’methanchi tam quin ulits c’al tata’chic.

Huahua’ tu abathuale yab i ulal max i bauchal o max i jalunchal in ey talchic i inic ax in cuete’ ulal pulic in ey. Yab u tsalpath max cu met’axin ani qui tsalpanchiq’ui max i bauchal o max yab i bauchal in ey i at inic ani jaye max i lejbayal i ey c’al i cuete’ tsalap.

Yab i huat’ath ajatnal i ey ani i t’ojlabil. Jats a Dios expith ax quin ulu ma ju’tam huichat qui baju cu t’ojon. Tu pithamalits an q’uij abal cu ulits ma c’al tata’chic ti Corinto cu t’ojon c’al an alhua’ cau.
Yab i huat’anchal jahua’ tu bijchamal a Dios tin cuenta i t’ojlabil c’al tata’chic. Pel huahua’its axi oc’ox ulits c’al tata’chic ani tu oc’ox olchamalchic an alhua’ cau tin cuenta a Cristo.

Yab i ulal abal pel i t’ojlabil max pel in t’ojlabil q’ue’at i inic axi t’ojnenec jaye c’al tata’chic. Expith i le’ tu tolminchichic ca más bela’ a Dios, ani max qui ejtou cu t’ojone c’al tata’chic ma ju’tam huichat quin ulu a Dios.
Talbel qui ne’tha’ an alhua’ cau más tihua’ jaye al pil i cuenchalabchic, ani antsana’ yab qui ajatnanchi in t’ojlabil axi q’ue’atchic i inic.
Ani max jita’ in le’ ti ajatnanchix, expith quin ajatnanchi jahua’ in t’ajal an Ajatic.
Yab jant’o ti exbath max i inic quin cuete’ ajatna’ tim ba’ abal pel i alhua’ inic, expith max ca ajatna c’al an Ajatic lej chubax pel i alhua’ inic.
